name: Andy Joseph Frasheski
description: Andy Frasheski is the owner of Frasheski Construction, a Berkeley-based residential remodeling company serving homeowners throughout the East Bay. A licensed general contractor with more than 40 years of experience, he specializes in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, home renovations, and additions, overseeing projects from planning through the plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, and finish-work stages.
